data.content_ref: inline:CONTRADICTION: SRC_002 and SRC_004 contradict SRC_005 on the question of whether a test should be written at all. SRC_002 says the cheapest test runs verify_root_report and asserts the output type, while SRC_005 says the delta 'may require investigation before a test is written' and that the discrepancy might be documentation-only. The contradiction is substantive: one prescribes a test immediately, the other defers testing pending design investigation. Refuted if the two artifacts are actually describing sequential phases of the same workflow (investigate-then-test) rather than opposing prescriptions.
